articles.title: Bengaluru: Man Arrested for Harassing Woman and Creating Ruckus at Indiranagar Hostel
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A man has been arrested for allegedly harassing a woman, abusing her and attempting to assault her at a hostel in Bengaluru. The incident reportedly took place on March 11 between 8:50 pm and 9:50 pm at a hostel located in the Indiranagar area.

body.html:
A man has been arrested for allegedly harassing a woman, abusing her and attempting to assault her at a hostel in Bengaluru.

The incident reportedly took place on March 11 between 8:50 pm and 9:50 pm at a hostel located in the Indiranagar area.

According to the complaint filed by a 28-year-old woman, the accused Manu Sharma, who was also staying at the same hostel, had been harassing her for several days and repeatedly pressuring her to enter into a relationship.

The woman stated that despite rejecting his advances, Sharma continued to trouble her and even tried to approach her through her friend Priyanka Prasad.

The situation escalated on the night of March 11 when the accused allegedly began shouting inside the hostel premises. According to the FIR, he used abusive and derogatory language against the woman and her friend, making obscene remarks targeting women staying at the hostel.

The complainant further alleged that Sharma attempted to physically assault both of them during the altercation.

The entire incident was reportedly captured on CCTV cameras installed inside the hostel.

Based on the complaint, police registered a case and arrested the accused. Officials said further investigation into the matter is ongoing.

articles.title: Kanpur: Woman Slaps Alleged ₹2 Crore Fraudster Inside Car, Viral Video Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic scene unfolded in Kanpur when a woman confronted and slapped a man accused of defrauding dozens of people of crores of rupees. The incident occurred near Chakeri Police Station on Saturday evening.

body.html:
A dramatic scene unfolded in Kanpur when a woman confronted and slapped a man accused of defrauding dozens of people of crores of rupees.

The incident occurred near Chakeri Police Station on Saturday evening. A video that surfaced later shows a woman entering a car and repeatedly slapping the accused while shouting, “He killed my father! I won’t let him go.”

The accused has been identified as Krishna Prakash Singhania, who is alleged to have cheated around 35 people of more than ₹2 crore in the name of investments, loans, land deals, business opportunities and stock market profits.

In the viral clip, Singhania can be seen sitting inside a car wearing a white shirt, while a woman in a yellow suit grabs him and slaps him repeatedly. When she accused him of withdrawing ₹20 lakh from her father’s account, he allegedly responded that the money belonged to someone else, which further enraged her.

People gathered around the car tried to calm the woman, but she continued beating the accused until bystanders intervened and handed him over to the police.

According to victims, Singhania had allegedly been evading them for months. On Saturday, he reportedly called several victims to Lal Bangla on the pretext of returning their money. When they confronted him on the way, an argument broke out that escalated into the assault.

After news of his detention spread, about a dozen victims reached the police station and filed complaints. Victims including Ravi Prakash, Vipin, Sharda, and Samreen Fatima alleged they had collectively lost more than ₹2 crore to the accused.

Police official Bhanu Pratap Singh confirmed that the accused has been detained and is being interrogated. Authorities said further legal action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation.

articles.title: Lucknow Tragedy: Class 12 Student Dies After Bullet Bike Crash Near Janeshwar Mishra Park
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic road accident in Lucknow claimed the life of a 18-year-old Class 12 student after his motorcycle crashed into a divider near Janeshwar Mishra Park. The deceased has been identified as Naitik Kumar, a resident of Gomti Nagar Extension.

body.html:
A tragic road accident in Lucknow claimed the life of a 18-year-old Class 12 student after his motorcycle crashed into a divider near Janeshwar Mishra Park.

The deceased has been identified as Naitik Kumar, a resident of Gomti Nagar Extension. His father, Ram Iqbal, works in the electricity department.

According to reports, Naitik had gone for a morning ride with friends Aditya Srivastava and Krishna Singh, each riding separate bikes. Around 7:30 am near Gate No. 5 of the park, the three were reportedly racing when a scooter suddenly came in front of Naitik, who was riding a Royal Enfield Bullet.

Before he could react, the Bullet collided with the scooter. The impact threw Naitik off the bike and he hit the road divider, suffering severe head injuries. Aditya, who was riding a Kawasaki Ninja behind him, also lost control and fell, while Krishna fell on the road as well.

Bystanders rushed the injured students to the hospital, where doctors declared Naitik dead during treatment. The other two sustained minor injuries and were later discharged.

While being taken to the hospital, Aditya reportedly recorded a video inside the ambulance. After learning about Naitik’s death, he shared the clip on social media with the message: “Everything ended in a moment.” The post has since gone viral.

Police from Gomti Nagar Extension Police Station said the body was taken into custody, but the family declined a post-mortem and took it to their ancestral village in Barabanki.

Station in-charge Sudhir Awasthi said nearby CCTV footage is being examined to determine the exact cause of the accident.

The incident has once again raised concerns about speeding and stunt riding by youngsters in the Gomti Nagar Extension area, where such videos frequently surface on social media.

#Lucknow #RoadAccident #JaneshwarMishraPark #BikeCrash #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #RoadSafety #IndiaNews

articles.title: Lucknow: Cop Accused of Beating Driver After Minor Car Collision in Indiranagar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A police officer in Lucknow has been accused of assaulting a car driver following a minor road collision in the Indiranagar area.

body.html:
A police officer in Lucknow has been accused of assaulting a car driver following a minor road collision in the Indiranagar area.

According to the complaint, Shamim Akhtar, a resident of Indiranagar Sector-21, said the incident occurred on March 15 at around 4:45 pm near Nani Hotel while he was turning his car onto Chandan Road.

Akhtar alleged that his vehicle had a minor collision with a speeding Maruti Swift. The driver of the Swift, reportedly wearing a police uniform, allegedly stepped out and began abusing him.

The victim claimed the man then pulled him out of his car, twisted his arms and repeatedly kicked and punched him, leaving him with serious injuries to both hands.

Shamim said he immediately dialed 112 to inform the police. Bystanders at the spot allegedly told him that the accused officer was Farhan, who is reportedly posted at the local police station.

According to the victim, the accused fled the scene after learning that the police control room had been alerted. A police team later arrived at the spot and recorded his statement.

Akhtar also said he possesses dashcam footage from his car and CCTV recordings from nearby cameras, which he is ready to submit as evidence.

Meanwhile, officials from the Indiranagar Police Station said an investigation will be conducted and a medical examination will follow. The victim stated that due to delays, he went to Balrampur Hospital himself for medical examination.

An FIR has been filed in the case, and the complainant has demanded strict action against the accused officer. Police say further action will depend on the outcome of the investigation.

#Lucknow #UttarPradesh #PoliceMisconduct #RoadRage #BreakingNews #IndiaNews #CCTVFootage #PoliceInvestigation

articles.title: Mathura: Woman Smashes Car Window, Thrashes Engineer Husband Over Second Marriage Allegation
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic street altercation in Mathura went viral after a woman allegedly attacked her engineer husband at a railway crossing over accusations that he had secretly married another woman.

body.html:
A dramatic street altercation in Mathura went viral after a woman allegedly attacked her engineer husband at a railway crossing over accusations that he had secretly married another woman.

The incident occurred on Saturday afternoon near the Mont Road Railway Crossing in Raya, when the railway gate was closed and vehicles were waiting in a long queue.

According to reports, Rachnesh Sharma spotted her husband Ravi sitting inside a car. Enraged, she allegedly picked up a brick and smashed the vehicle’s window, hitting him.

When Ravi stepped out of the car, the woman reportedly grabbed his hair and began beating him on the road. Shortly afterward, her brother arrived with two friends, and the group allegedly assaulted the engineer using a broom and by slapping and punching him repeatedly.

A large crowd gathered at the spot as the commotion continued for some time, and several bystanders recorded videos of the incident.

According to the woman, Ravi misled the family and secretly married another woman in Punjab, which led to the confrontation.

Police from the local station reached the scene and took both parties to the station for questioning. Officials said the couple married in 2007 and have two children.

Meanwhile, Ravi’s mother Sarvesh alleged that her daughter-in-law had previously assaulted family members and forced them out of their home in the village.

Police said both sides are being questioned and further action will be taken after the investigation.

articles.title: Burglary Bid Foiled in Hathras: Masked Men Try to Break Into Jewellery Shop, Flee With CCTV Cameras
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A late-night burglary attempt at a jewellery shop in Hathras was foiled after miscreants fled the scene as the market area began to get crowded. The incident took place around 3:30 am on Saturday night at Chauhan Jewelers, located at Rathi Square in Sikandrarao town.

body.html:
A late-night burglary attempt at a jewellery shop in Hathras was foiled after miscreants fled the scene as the market area began to get crowded.

The incident took place around 3:30 am on Saturday night at Chauhan Jewelers, located at Rathi Square in Sikandrarao town.

According to reports, three to four masked men arrived at the shop and first uprooted the CCTV cameras installed above the entrance to avoid being identified. They then tried to break open the locks of the shop shutters.

Shop owner Vinod Kumar Chauhan said the locks showed clear signs of tampering and vandalism.

However, as morning approached and movement began increasing in the market, the miscreants panicked and fled the spot without stealing any jewellery. While escaping, they reportedly took two uprooted CCTV cameras with them.

The incident came to light on Sunday morning when Vinod Chauhan arrived to open the shop and found the damaged locks and missing cameras. Local residents gathered at the spot, and police were informed.

Police officials said that although the cameras were removed, the recording system had stored footage until the moment they were uprooted. The footage reportedly shows three to four young men, though their faces are only partially visible.

City in-charge Ramnaresh said patrolling teams were active in the area at the time. Meanwhile, Shiv Kumar Sharma confirmed that a complaint has been registered and an investigation is underway.

Police said efforts are being made to identify and arrest the accused based on the available CCTV footage.

#Hathras #UttarPradesh #BurglaryAttempt #JewelleryShop #CrimeNews #CCTVFootage #BreakingNews #PoliceInvestigation

articles.title: Morena Viral Video: Woman Breaks Down at Gas Agency After Being Denied LPG Cylinder
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic scene from Morena has gone viral on social media, where a woman allegedly slipped into a trance-like state after repeatedly failing to get a domestic LPG cylinder.

body.html:
A dramatic scene from Morena has gone viral on social media, where a woman allegedly slipped into a trance-like state after repeatedly failing to get a domestic LPG cylinder.

The incident reportedly took place in the Joura area, where several residents had gathered at a gas agency to collect cooking gas cylinders.

According to people present at the spot, the woman had been visiting the agency for several days but was unable to obtain a cylinder due to supply issues. Frustrated and emotionally distressed, she began crying loudly inside the agency premises and pleaded with the staff to provide her one.

In the viral video, the woman can be seen sitting on the ground, crying and repeatedly requesting the employees for a gas cylinder while others around her try to calm her down.

Some bystanders claimed during the incident that the woman appeared to be possessed by Kali, although this claim has not been verified.

Locals say that the shortage of domestic LPG cylinders in the area has forced many residents to make repeated visits to gas agencies in recent days.

So far, neither the local administration nor the gas agency has issued an official statement regarding the viral video. However, the clip has sparked widespread discussion on social media about LPG supply issues in the region.

articles.title: Shocking Video: Hospital Staff Allegedly Drink Alcohol Inside Pathology Lab in Varanasi
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A controversial video has surfaced from Varanasi, showing hospital employees allegedly consuming alcohol and smoking inside the pathology department of Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay Government Hospital.

body.html:
A controversial video has surfaced from Varanasi, showing hospital employees allegedly consuming alcohol and smoking inside the pathology department of Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay Government Hospital.

The viral footage, which reportedly surfaced on Saturday, shows three men sitting around a table placed between pathology machines with glasses of alcohol, snacks and cigarettes. A fourth person is seen recording the video. Two separate clips of around 20 seconds each have circulated on social media.

In the video, a person is seen opening the lab refrigerator, taking out items, placing them on a plate and joining the others at the table. Moments later, another individual lights a cigarette inside the lab cabin.

The incident has raised serious concerns because the pathology lab is used to conduct blood tests for patients visiting the hospital’s emergency and outpatient departments, including samples from pregnant women.

Chief Medical Superintendent R. S. Ram said the video has come to his notice and an investigation has been ordered.

He stated that the footage appears to be from before he took charge but described the act as highly inappropriate. “The video is being investigated. After the probe, strict action will be taken against those responsible,” he said.

Hospital authorities are currently trying to identify the lab technicians and contract staff visible in the footage. Officials said strict disciplinary action will be taken if the allegations are confirmed.

The incident has sparked concern among patients and staff, raising questions about workplace discipline and hygiene standards inside a critical medical facility.
